name: Manidens
sum: A small Early to Middle Jurassic heterodontosaurid from Patagonia, about 60 cm long, with high-crowned herbivorous teeth.
wsnote: About 60 cm and 500 g, according to the English Wikipedia revision cited.
holotype: MPEF-PV 3211, a partial skeleton from the Queso Rallado locality, Cañadón Asfalto Formation, Chubut, Argentina, with skull, lower jaw, most of the axial column except the tail, left shoulder girdle and pelvis.
material: Isolated teeth and partial articulated specimens from the same locality, such as MPEF-PV 3809 and MPEF-PV 1719.
biology: High-crowned teeth suggest adaptation to a herbivorous diet, but without the wear facets of more advanced forms like Heterodontosaurus. Filaments are known in the related Tianyulong, so they may also have been present, but none are preserved.
author: Pol et al. 2011
